plan.summary:
Switch new `Record` IDs from random UUIDv4 to time-ordered UUIDv7, so IDs sort by creation time.

- `Cargo.toml`: the `uuid` crate feature changes from `v4` to `v7`.
- `Cargo.lock`: records the new transitive dependencies (`js-sys`, `rand`).
- `Record::new` now calls `Uuid::now_v7()` instead of `Uuid::new_v4()`.
plan.riskRationale: Small change with one call site. Existing IDs stay valid. New IDs are now ordered by time, which can reveal creation time and may change index or sort behavior.
plan.storyArc: The `uuid` feature flag is changed first, because the v7 generator only exists with that feature. `Record::new` then uses the v7 generator to create IDs.

topics.title: Generate record IDs as time-ordered UUIDv7
topics.narrativeBrief: How does a new `Record` get its ID now, and what dependency change makes that possible? Connect the `v7` feature flag, the lockfile additions, and the `Uuid::now_v7()` call. Verify that no other code still relies on `v4`.
